raw_text: THREAD: Ceasefire violation in Poonch sector confirmed by multiple ground sources. Small arms + 82mm mortar fire from Pakistan side. Indian Army has responded with proportional fire. At least 3 border villages — Shahpur, Kirni, Balakote — under evacuation orders. First major CFV since Feb 2021 ceasefire understanding.
clean_text: Ceasefire violation in Poonch confirmed. Small arms and 82mm mortar fire from Pakistan. Indian Army responded proportionally. Three villages under evacuation.
